notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: Yellow bollards with a white reflector, found on almost every rural road. Unique to this country.

notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Plates are all white with blue characters and, unlike most of Europe, have no blue EU strip on the left.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Barren, treeless land with dark grey volcanic soil; it looks like nowhere else in northern Europe.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Geologically active terrain: lava fields, geothermal lakes, rift valleys and towering rock formations.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Direction signs are yellow with a white inset box for the road number. A dashed box means a nearby road, not the one you are on.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Signs for very local places such as farms are usually blue or white instead of yellow.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: The pedestrian sign has four stripes and often a slight yellow tint. It is the only yellow-backed one in Europe.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Chevrons are black with yellow arrows.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Street name signs are white with black text and a thin metal rim, often mounted on lampposts or traffic lights.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: All road lines are white; there are no yellow lines. Yellow lines in a northern setting point to Norway or Finland.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: Letters ð, þ and æ, plus accented vowels á é í ó ö ú ý. The ð also appears in Faroese; æ in Danish and Norwegian.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Newest coverage was shot from red and white pickup trucks, well blurred. Red is the southwest, white the northeast.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: The ring road around the island is route 1. Other roads start with a digit from 2 (south) rising clockwise to 9.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Many narrow fjords ringed by moderately tall, mostly flat-topped mountains.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Fjords here have larger, more jagged mountains than the northwest ones.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Flat farmland dotted with farmsteads and meadows, with mountains far in the distance.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Glaciers spill from the big ice cap toward the sea, visible from the ring road.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Dark volcanic gravel with almost no vegetation or signs of life; most such covered roads are in the east.
